content:
We need to produce correct XML tags. Let's do a tool call.

<thought>We need a Wittig reaction template ID. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target SMILES of product and criteria breaking aldehyde to alkene.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehyde"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
